NURITEO self-hosted core API server

Usage: nuriteo-server <COMMAND>

Commands:
  serve
          Run the API server
  migrate
          Apply forward-only database migrations
  upgrade-preflight
          Validate a supported upgrade without changing the database
  bootstrap-admin
          Create the first instance administrator when none exists
  healthcheck
          Check deployment readiness
  storage-check
          Check configured object storage capabilities
  storage-configure-browser-upload-cors
          Explicitly replace bucket CORS with the NURITEO browser upload policy
  backup
          Create, verify, transfer, restore, and prune backups
  recovery-kit
          Export, inspect, verify, and restore an encrypted Secret Recovery Kit
  help
          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -V, --version  Print version
  -h, --help     Print help
